parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the ASM instance.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the ASM instances.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to `servicemesh`.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. A maximum of 20 tags are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type servicemesh --resource-id c418807cb4e5840eab018da7d8f5d0000 --tag Value=yahaha Key=test --next-token example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 c418807cb4e5840eab018da7d8f5d0000 --Tag.1.Key test --NextToken 'example-string' --Tag.1.Value yahaha --ResourceType servicemesh --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --method POST --force
